name: Learn basic bo staff spinning
blurb: Staff spinning is martial-arts flourish rather than combat: figure-eights, hand spins and a shoulder roll cover the visually impressive basics.
gear: A light staff — foam or rattan for learning, not hardwood
Plenty of open space, ideally outdoors
steps: Learn to find the balance point by feel; almost everything is spun from the centre.
Learn the basic figure-eight in front of your body, driven by wrist rotation and a hand-over-hand switch.
Learn the single-hand spin at your side, keeping the plane vertical and close to your body.
Add the hand release and catch, first as a small hop from one hand to the other.
Learn a shoulder or neck roll for a transition between sides.
Chain four moves into a smooth 20-second flow.
tips: Start with a foam staff. A hardwood staff into your own shin will end the fortnight.
Check your surroundings every time. Ceilings, lampshades and bystanders all lose.
proof: You flow through figure-eights, a side spin and a release catch without stopping or hitting yourself.
